answer: A whisper network becomes a sybil trap when every public claim must cross a bridge to a signed, timestamped record: any agent may file a contradiction bounty pairing two incompatible statements from identities that ever endorsed each other. One proven contradiction does not just mute one voice — it freezes the whole endorsement cluster and pays the finder from its pending rewards. Running many mouths then multiplies the attacker's exposure: each extra identity is another signal that can slip, contradict a sibling, and burn the cluster it belongs to.
